summary: Mechanome GROUNDED claims across five modules: 1 real force-paired (membrane) + 4 analytic-limit (tissue, cortex, bond, channel).

claims.subject: POPC_bilayer
evidence: STED tube diameter 51 nm (Roy et al. 2020, doi:10.1021/acs.nanolett.9b05232)
claims.reasoning_trace: aspiration tension 72 uN/m -> STED radius 25.6 nm -> Bayesian inverse -> force 24.1 pN [17.6,32.6] (68%); ground-truth aspiration force 23.2 pN lies in CI.

claims.subject: tricellular_junction
evidence: Ishihara & Sugimura 2012 J Theor Biol 313:201 (Bayesian force inference)
claims.reasoning_trace: A tri-cellular junction in force balance transmits equal edge tensions at 120 deg opening angles (Young); the vertex forward model reproduces this analytic limit exactly. GROUNDED on the analytic force-balance limit + method anchor (Ishihara 2012), NOT on a real segmented-tissue dataset.

claims.subject: actomyosin_cortex
evidence: Tinevez et al. 2009 PNAS 106:18581 (micropipette cortical tension 0.03-1 mN/m)
claims.reasoning_trace: The actomyosin cortex generates a surface tension read out via the Young-Laplace balance dP=2 gamma/R; a synthetic micropipette measurement recovers gamma in the physiological range. GROUNDED on the Laplace analytic limit + anchor (Tinevez 2009), NOT on a real aspiration dataset.

claims.subject: adhesion_bond
evidence: Marshall et al. 2003 Nature 423:190 (P-selectin/PSGL-1 catch-slip, peak ~1.1 s)
catch-slip lifetime peak 0.14 s at 22.4 pN (analytic=numeric)
claims.reasoning_trace: A catch-slip adhesion bond bears force with a lifetime that peaks at an intermediate force (dkoff/dF=0); the two-pathway forward model matches the closed-form peak. GROUNDED on the Bell/catch-slip analytic limit + anchor (Marshall 2003), NOT on a real AFM dataset.

claims.subject: MscL
evidence: Sukharev et al. 1999 J Gen Physiol 113:525 (MscL: sigma_half=11.8 mN/m, dA=6.5 nm^2)
cross-scale: reads curvo membrane tension (Po=0.5 at midpoint)
claims.reasoning_trace: MscL senses membrane tension via a two-state Boltzmann gating law; it half-opens at sigma_half=11.8 mN/m (gating area 6.5 nm^2). The forward model reads curvo's inferred membrane tension directly — the one cross-scale link grounded on both ends. GROUNDED on the MscL gating analytic limit + anchor (Sukharev 1999), NOT on a real patch-clamp dataset.
